0.0.2.en: Added Service Zone setting to all device drivers and updated Speaker Hub flow action to include service zone when sending command. Added insights titles to Door Sensor device driver. Changed 'Window / Door Sensor' as device name in Door Sensor driver. Added Flow action to play tones on Speaker Hub.

1.0.4.en: Enhanced localization strings for UAID selection instructions., Trimmed whitespace from UAID and Secret Key inputs to prevent user errors. Added error handling for failed access token retrieval during device pairing.

1.0.5.en: Added Vibration Sensor device driver. Fix EU/UK region support when fetching device lists. Fix sending of device logs to developer. Enhanced error logging.

1.0.6.en: Added Siren, Motion sensor and Power Fail Alarm device driver. Added more diagnostics to MQTT setup process. Now waits for MQTT setup to complete before returning from setup function.

1.0.7.en: Fixed issue with MQTT reconnect logic causing excessive connection attempts. Improved stability of MQTT connection handling.

1.0.9.en: Fixed issue with MQTT client setup for US and us_west_1 zone discrepency. Changed Smart Remote device offline behavior. Added more logging to check status updates.

1.0.10.en: Updated images. Schedule retry logic for MQTT connection to use exponential backoff to reduce connection attempts during outages.

1.0.11.en: Added error traps on all setCapabilityValue calls to improve stability.

1.0.12.en: Fix Siren On / Off Flow action card handler.
